name: koalafix-auto
description: Makes KoalaFix automatic in Codex: the team brief and current decisions at session start, recall on each prompt, a warning before the agent edits a file a teammate has checked in on, work in progress started and closed for you. Install it beside the koalafix plugin, then trust the hooks in /hooks. Sends each prompt (keys and tokens taken out, never logged) and the paths of files it names or the session edits to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and those paths. Needs Node.js 22 or later.

interface.shortDescription: Team memory on every prompt, with no asking
